Text.Text: The chamber is safe to reclaim. Build walls that protect the people inside them. You've finished my Emergency Bunker trials. I have no further work for you here.
I certify these trials at rank 50 in Devices. Reach that rank, then come back. A shelter needs steady hands before it needs thicker walls.

A crew has sealed part of the engineering bunker and rebuilt it without approval. Their docket will tell me what they've changed. Defeat six Emergency Bunker Adepts in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Emergency Bunker Republic Bunker Docket; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Exterior. I'll give you the Viscara Republic Engineering Bunker Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Emergency Bunker.

Here's the Viscara Republic Engineering Bunker Key. Use 'Republic Engineering Bunker' in Viscara, Republic Base, Combat Deck. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Emergency Bunker Adepts, then return with the Emergency Bunker Republic Bunker Docket.
Anyone caught under a collapsing structure with nowhere left to retreat to. That's the whole doctrine, really: hold a space that holds people, no matter what's falling on top of it.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Emergency Bunker Adept fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.
Every load rating and structural change they've logged since they took it over. I need to know if they've weakened something I'm going to have to trust with lives again.

Defeat six Emergency Bunker Adepts in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Emergency Bunker Republic Bunker Docket; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Exterior.
You've defeated six Emergency Bunker Adepts. Let me see the Emergency Bunker Republic Bunker Docket.
Now I have a record of their modifications. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists are using the shield relay to support unsafe modifications. Bring it back for inspection. Defeat five Emergency Bunker Specialists in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Emergency Bunker Shield Grid Relay; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Exterior.
Your key still grants access to Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Defeat five Emergency Bunker Specialists to secure the Emergency Bunker Shield Grid Relay, then return to me.

They tied the shield failsafe to the same circuit as the structural load sensors. Cut power to one and you cut warning to the other. That's not a design choice, that's a shortcut, and shortcuts in a bunker get people buried.

Because whoever's running this operation needed something clever enough to fool an inspection and lazy enough to save them a week's work. Specialists are exactly the people who can manage both at once.
I separate the circuits back out where they belong, the way I built it the first time. Then that sublevel goes back to being the safest room in the bunker instead of the most dangerous one.

Defeat five Emergency Bunker Specialists in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Emergency Bunker Shield Grid Relay; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Exterior.
You've defeated five Emergency Bunker Specialists. Let me see the Emergency Bunker Shield Grid Relay.
I'll inspect this before anything goes back into service. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden holds the altered chamber. Recover the command crest so I can trace the orders behind the work. Defeat the Emergency Bunker Warden in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Emergency Bunker Cracked Command Crest; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Exterior. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Emergency Bunker Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Emergency Bunker Cracked Command Crest.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Emergency Bunker Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.
Cracked under load like that means he's been running that chamber past its rated tolerance for a while now. I need to know exactly how far past, before I trust it to hold anyone again, including you.
Turned my deepest shelter into his personal fortress and dared anyone to come collect the rent. I built that chamber to keep people alive under anything. I did not build it for him.

Defeat the Emergency Bunker Warden in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Emergency Bunker Cracked Command Crest; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Exterior. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Emergency Bunker Warden. Let me see the Emergency Bunker Cracked Command Crest.
That confirms who was in charge of the unsafe work. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four quartermasters are still authorizing materials for the crew. Recover their override chip. Defeat four members of the Emergency Bunker Inner Circle in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Emergency Bunker Quartermaster Override Chip; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Exterior.

Your key still grants access to Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Defeat four members of the Emergency Bunker Inner Circle to secure the Emergency Bunker Quartermaster Override Chip, then return to me.
Every requisition, every signature, every load of concrete and cable that went into re-rigging my own sublevel against me. It's a paper trail with a name at the end of it.
Someone with enough standing to move Republic materials without a second signature. That's a very short list, and I'm dreading which name is on it.
Keep them close if you can. Four together is a heavier lift than one warden, in its own way, and I'd rather you go in with hands you already trust.

Defeat four members of the Emergency Bunker Inner Circle in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Emergency Bunker Quartermaster Override Chip; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Exterior.
You've defeated four members of the Emergency Bunker Inner Circle. Let me see the Emergency Bunker Quartermaster Override Chip.
No more unauthorized orders from that crew. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

The master has turned shelter doctrine into a way to trap people. Defeat him in the command room and end it. Defeat the Emergency Bunker Master in Viscara, Engineering Command Room. Report back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Exterior; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Viscara, Engineering Command Room, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Emergency Bunker Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.
A shelter holds you alive until help arrives. A trap holds you until it doesn't matter anymore whether help does. He's mistaken one for the other, and I intend to correct him personally, through you.
Long enough to convince himself patience is the same as strength. It isn't. Strength is knowing when a room's already decided against you and leaving before it does.

Then Emergency Bunker goes back to what I built it for: holding people who need holding, not men who think walls make them untouchable. That's yours now, properly, and I trust you'll keep it that way.

Defeat the Emergency Bunker Master in Viscara, Engineering Command Room. Report back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Exterior; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Emergency Bunker Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The chamber is safe to reclaim. Build walls that protect the people inside them. You've earned the right to train Emergency Bunker. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the drill.
I'll defeat six Emergency Bunker Adepts.
What does emergency bunker doctrine actually protect?
Would you recommend bringing help?
What will the docket tell you?
Not today, I've got other work.
Here's the Emergency Bunker Republic Bunker Docket.
Back to the drill.
I'll defeat five Emergency Bunker Specialists.
How does a shield relay affect load-bearing supports?
Why do specialists get assigned to rig something this dangerous?
What happens once you have the relay back?
I need a day first.
Here's the Emergency Bunker Shield Grid Relay.
Back to the drill.
I'll defeat the Emergency Bunker Warden.
Would you recommend bringing help?
What does the crest tell you?
What's the warden actually done to that chamber?
I need to find people first.
Here's the Emergency Bunker Cracked Command Crest.
Back to the drill.
I'll defeat four members of the Emergency Bunker Inner Circle.
What's recorded on that chip?
Who has authority to requisition bunker materials?
Should I bring the same two as before?
Give me a little time.
Here's the Emergency Bunker Quartermaster Override Chip.
Back to the drill.
I'll face the Emergency Bunker Master and report back.
What makes those walls a trap instead of a shelter for him?
How long has he been down there?
What happens to Emergency Bunker doctrine once he's gone?
I need a little more time before this one.
The Emergency Bunker Master is defeated. Here's my report.
